  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind

    right

            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind

            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind

        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>

        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl with

    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl with

        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
